history.title: Under pressure
history.prompt: The coach cranks up pressure in a finishing drill: limited touches, live whistle, crowded boxes. Mistakes are punished with extra runs.
history.choiceLabel: Play at normal tempo and accept the odd mistake
history.outcomeText: A rushed shot after a heavy touch earns you the extra run. The setback is real, though your overall remains 71 for now. Overall: 71 → 71

history.title: First national camp
history.prompt: Your first national-team camp brings nerves and unfamiliar teammates. Camp rhythms are different from club football, and adaptation speed matters. You decide how to seek guidance, stay steady, or isolate.
history.choiceLabel: Focus on the routines and enjoy the occasion
history.outcomeText: Presence without panic; you mirror sleep and meal habits and train cleanly. Overall: 70 → 71  (+1)

history.title: Measurement review
history.prompt: Sports science shares your latest sprint and load numbers beside video from yesterday. The staff ask how you want to use the feedback this week.
history.choiceLabel: Take the numbers as context and train as planned
history.outcomeText: You match effort to the recommended band and stay consistent. You made useful progress, though your overall remains 71 for now. Overall: 71 → 71

history.title: New teammate
history.prompt: A new signing speaks little of the dressing-room language yet. Calls in training are getting missed on your side of the pitch.
history.choiceLabel: Shout simpler English commands during the drill
history.outcomeText: They misread a shout and the coach stops play frustrated. The setback is real, though your overall remains 71 for now. Overall: 71 → 71
